notes: Combined POI. 용두암길 15 is the address KTO gives for Yongduam (it is the public parking lot). Yongyeon (용연/용연구름다리) separately: 제주시 흥운길 73, always open, free, restroom available, no dedicated parking (KTO). Phone is the Jeju City Tourist Information Center, not a site office; no official site-specific website (KTO lists visitjeju.net). KTO 무장애 page (modified 2026-11-10) lists only: accessible parking zone, restroom (under the mobility-impairment section, read as accessible restroom; no stall specs), and visually-impaired guide staff 4x/day; it gives NO access-route/wheelchair info, so wheelchair_ok left null. Stairs to the lower viewpoint and slippery basalt are from a 2022 visitor blog. Yongyeon Cloud Bridge is a swaying suspension bridge (blog); step/slope details on the Yongyeon path not confirmed. avg_stay_min is an estimate.

Official fee page (checked 2026-11) still shows night opening dated 'May 1 - Oct 31, 2025'; a 2026 news article reports the same May-Oct 18:00-21:00, Mon/Tue-excluded scheme for 2026. As of today (Nov 11) night opening is over. KTO has no 무장애 entry for 목관아 itself; accessibility values come from the adjacent Gwandeokjeong (관덕로 19) KTO 무장애 page: 2 accessible parking spaces in public lot west of Gwandeokjeong, step-free to entrance 'with steps in some sections', ramp at main entrance, wheelchair rental, restroom. Whether the restroom is a dedicated accessible one, and whether it is inside 목관아, is unconfirmed (accessible_restroom null). Restroom presence and free parking from KTO TourAPI (ktriptips). Raised building platforms/steps observed in KTO photo. Korean-language guide service by reservation (064-710-6746). English name: official usage varies (Jeju Mokgwana / Jeju-mok Government Office). avg_stay_min is an estimate.

Fee conflict: KTO TourAPI (via ktriptips) shows adult 4,000 KRW; older trazy listing shows 2,500 KRW and 08:00-17:00 hours (treated as outdated). Official site samsunghyeol.or.kr could not be fetched (TLS certificate mismatch), so fees/hours are not confirmed directly from the operator. KTO 무장애 page (modified 2026-11-10): 1 accessible parking space; route to entrance flat but with dirt/stone sections; entrance has a ramp, no step, very gentle slope; 2 wheelchairs for rent; restroom listed under mobility-impairment section (read as accessible restroom, specs not given); Braille map at entrance; low-floor buses 365/370 to Boseong Market stop. Interior steps (e.g., shrine hall) not documented -> has_stairs null. has_seating based on KTO listing a rest area (휴게소). Rites held Apr 10, Oct 10 and Dec 10. Foreign-language animation video and EN/JP/CN pamphlets available. avg_stay_min is an estimate.

Hours conflict: official visitor-guide page says 09:00-18:00 (last entry 17:30), but the homepage banner shows 10:00-18:00 and mentions online advance reservation; the KTO English listing (data ~2021) shows weekends/holidays 10:00-19:00 plus some late Saturday/Wednesday openings. Used the official visitor-guide page; recommend re-checking. KTO 무장애 page: accessible parking (6 spaces, front and rear gates), ramp to entrance, wheelchair rental (manual and electric), elevator, restroom (mobility section; read as accessible restroom), seating listed, audio-guide app, Braille materials at gallery entrance, stroller rental at 1F info desk, nursing room, diaper table. has_stairs=true inferred from multi-level building with elevator; a step-free route exists via ramp/elevator. Children's museum reopened after renovation in late 2025 (third-party). Current exhibition: Kim Young-gap donated photo exhibition until 2027-03-01 (MCST). avg_stay_min is an estimate.

Official site notices: closed Nov 23-24, 2026 (Mon-Tue) for collection disinfection; audio-visual room renovation Sep-Nov 2026 with possible construction noise. KTO 무장애 page: 2 accessible parking spaces, ramp to and at main entrance (wheelchair accessible), wheelchair rental, elevator, restroom (mobility section; read as accessible restroom), Braille signage, stroller rental at ticket office (ID required), nursing room. Main front staircase seen in KTO photo. has_seating based on official description of Gallery Bengdiwat as a rest space overlooking the central garden. Mainly indoor but outdoor exhibits are part of the visit. Phone for guidance department listed as 064-710-7710 on fee page. avg_stay_min is an estimate.

Hours conflict: VisitJeju KR (updated 2026-11-11) gives market 07:00-21:00 and seasonal night-market hours; KTO data (ktriptips mirror) and older listings give 08:00-21:00 and night market 18:00-24:00 year-round. Used VisitJeju. Night market currently (Nov) 18:00 start. Jibun differs: VisitJeju lists 이도일동 1436-7 vs source data 일도일동 1491-1; road address 관덕로14길 20 is consistent across VisitJeju and KTO. English VisitJeju lists the customer support centre at 14 Gwandeok-ro. Restroom 'available' per KTO-derived listing; a visitor blog says restrooms are in the public parking building (elevator to ground floor). No official wheelchair/accessible-restroom data found; a parenting site says strollers can get through but aisles get very crowded. official_url is the VisitJeju (Jeju Tourism Organization) page; no standalone market website confirmed. avg_stay is an estimate.

Address/phone conflict: VisitJeju (updated 2026-11-11) = 사라봉동길 74 (건입동), 064-728-3605; KTO data (ktriptips mirror, updated 2026-11-11) = 사라봉길 75 (건입동), 064-728-4643. Used VisitJeju. English name: VisitJeju 'Sarabong Park', KTO 'Sarabong Peak'. Height cited as 148 m in most sources, 143 m in one. Accessibility: VisitJeju barrier-free fields list '단차없음' (no level change) but rate assistance need as '아주 어려움' (very difficult) - conflicting, so wheelchair_ok set false based on the overall rating. has_stairs based on VisitJeju photos showing stone stairways in the park. has_seating based on KTO listing of an octagonal pavilion (팔각정) and exercise facilities. Restroom 'available' per KTO. Image licence on VisitJeju is not published; a Commons alternative is only a nearby road photo (File:Sarabong-gil, Jeju-si, Jeju-do, South Korea - panoramio.jpg, CC BY 3.0). avg_stay is an estimate (one visitor review suggests ~1 hour walk). Category could also be oreum_hike.

No dedicated phone; VisitJeju/KTO refer visitors to the Jeju Tourist Information Center 064-740-6000. Jibun conflict: VisitJeju 도두일동 산 2, VisitJeju EN 산 1, source data 산 3-2; road address 도두항길 4-17 (trailhead) consistent in VisitJeju and KTO. Height 67 m per Wikipedia. VisitJeju lists convenience facilities 화장실 and 유도 및 안내시설, no barrier-free facilities, and rates assistance need '아주 어려움' (very difficult) -> wheelchair_ok false. KTO lists separate men/women restrooms at Dodubong Park. has_stairs based on Commons photo File:Dodubong_09.jpg showing a stepped trail. Summit seating not confirmed. Climb time and avg_stay are estimates; fatigue 2 because the climb is short despite being an oreum. Pets on leash allowed per VisitJeju. Night-time visits possible but trail lighting not confirmed.

Name: VisitJeju title '이호테우해수욕장'; KTO uses '이호테우해변'. Jibun conflict: VisitJeju 이호2동 1600-1 vs source data 이호일동 1599-1. 2026 season dates (Jun 24 - Sep 6) and hours (10:00-19:00, night to 21:00 Jul 15 - Aug 15) come from news/blog summaries, not an official notice I could open; VisitJeju EN text is older ('open through end of August, night 19:00-21:00'). Out of season (now, November) there is no lifeguard swimming. Accessibility: in summer 2026 Jeju City ran Iho Tewoo as a pilot 'barrier-free beach' with 2 free amphibious wheelchairs and life jackets, and reported a short, well-kept route from the parking lot to the sand; the pilot ended Sep 6, 2026 and continuation is undecided -> wheelchair_ok 'partial'. No source on accessible restrooms/showers (article notes showering is hard for wheelchair users). Restroom and public parking per VisitJeju convenience list; seating based on VisitJeju mention of a viewing rest area (전망휴게소) plus pavilion/boardwalk seen in Commons photos. avg_stay is an estimate.

Hours from the official arboretum site; it says outdoor areas are 'always open' and also 'walkable until 23:00' - treat as open until 23:00 in practice. VisitJeju EN wrongly lists winter hours as 09:00-18:00; official = 09:00-17:00 Dec-Feb. Accessibility from VisitJeju barrier-free fields (updated 2026-11-11): independent access possible, no level changes, low-floor bus access, accessible restroom, elevator, accessible parking, manual wheelchair rental; assistance need rated '쉬움' (easy). Caveat: the forest-bathing trail climbs Gwangi Oreum and was not checked for steps, so has_stairs left null. Seating: official site lists 3 pergolas and a multipurpose rest area. Picnic food only in the designated area below the parking lot; no pets. Commons alternative image: File:Arboretum_of_Halla1.jpg (User:Mar del Este, CC BY 3.0, night shot). avg_stay is an estimate (VisitJeju story says it takes more than an hour to explore).

FEE CONFLICT: the official museum fee page lists adult 8,000 KRW, with no effective date; KTO (TourAPI), access.visitkorea, VisitJeju and MCST exhibition listings all say 2,000 KRW. I could not find a news report of a fee increase, so I used the official figure; recheck it. KTO accessibility listing says there are no steps at the entrance and no indoor level changes, plus an elevator, free wheelchair and stroller rental, accessible parking and a nursing room. It says 'restroom available' but does not say whether it is accessible. has_stairs=false is about the visitor route only, based on that listing. Delmoondo cafe on site. avg_stay_min is an estimate. Jibun in the 2015 data (연동 680-7) differs from the current road address; the road address above is the one all current sources use.

ADDRESS CONFLICT: VisitJeju and Wheelnavi give 조함해안로 525 (jibun 함덕리 1004-10); KTO and access.visitkorea give 조함해안로 519-10. I used 525. Wheelnavi (Jeju barrier-free tourism site) lists accessible parking, separate men's and women's accessible restrooms, and pergola/pavilion rest spots, and says there is no assistive-device rental. Its warnings: the promenade is narrow and has drain covers; the lawn plaza and the end of the Seoubong path are reached by stairs; there is a 5-9 deg downhill from the parking lot. No beach wheelchair or mat is documented. Accessible parking is at the control-center lot. A visitor review on VisitJeju says there are no showers, only taps; this is unofficial. The east end has a dog-swim zone in summer. avg_stay_min is an estimate; add 40-60 min if climbing Seoubong (an oreum).

access.visitkorea lists a ramp entrance to the hall, an elevator, wheelchair rental, stroller rental at the info desk and 2 accessible parking spaces. It says 'restroom available' but not whether it is accessible. Accessible restrooms are confirmed by Wheelnavi (separate men's and women's) and by Dooritogether/jejudoori (1F and 2F of the hall, plus outside the Peace Education Center). An older KTO listing marked accessible facilities as absent; it looks outdated. Wheelchair users are advised to bring a companion because of the 330 m slope and some unpaved stretches. Accessible parking is in parking lot 3 (jejudoori). Multilingual commentary videos are available (KO/EN/ZH/JA/KSL). Wheelnavi lists a cafe. Seating/benches were not confirmed. The hall is a 4-storey building plus basement. This is an emotionally heavy topic. avg_stay_min is an estimate (hall about 60-90 min plus grounds).

HOURS CONFLICT: KTO and access.visitkorea give the seasonal 07-18 / 07-17 hours; VisitJeju lists entry 07:00-17:00 year-round. Today (Nov) both agree on 07:00-17:00. Fees come from KTO/ktriptips; the foresttrip official page does not list them. Parking fees come from a third-party listing. access.visitkorea lists 3 accessible parking spaces, an accessible restroom, 3 manual wheelchairs and 4 strollers to borrow (ask at the ticket office), and a deck/ramp main route through the cedars that is easy by wheelchair. has_stairs=false applies to the main walking routes only; the Jeolmul Oreum climb is a separate, steeper trail. wheelchair_ok is 'partial' because only the deck routes are suitable. has_seating=true is based on benches visible at the entrance in the KTO photo. The source data's '국립' label: the land is Korea Forest Service national forest, but on-site operation is by Jeju City's 절물생태관리소. The jibun (봉개동 산 78-1) matches VisitJeju. Some trails were closed for maintenance Mar-Jun 2026 and have reopened (Jul 2026 news). avg_stay_min is an estimate.

Opening hours not confirmed from an official source. A search summary of EasyJeju data (surveyed 2023) gave 11:00-22:00 (last order 21:00), closed Mon. Trazy gives 10:00-21:00 daily. Both are unverified, so opening_hours is null. VisitJeju contradicts itself: its metadata says alternate Mondays closed, its text says every Monday. Jibun: VisitJeju gives 건입동 984-41 (EasyJeju 984-56), which differs from the 2015 data (1292). Run by the Geonip-dong village cooperative. Accessibility comes from EasyJeju (Jeju Tourist Accessibility Center), surveyed 2023-06-09: no accessible parking or accessible restroom; 11 cm step at the viewing-hall entrance; slopes up to 13 deg; stairs in the indoor table area; and an obstacle at the tavern entrance that makes wheelchair use difficult. Whether there is a general restroom is not confirmed. Pets allowed per VisitJeju tags. Thatched-house photo checked visually. It is a .webp file from the VisitJeju CDN (returns HTTP 200, image/webp); the KTO set for this area shows only the memorial hall. NEARBY Kim Man-deok Memorial Hall (김만덕기념관): 산지로 7, 064-759-6090, www.mandukmuseum.or.kr, 09:00-18:00, closed Mon (next weekday if Mon is a holiday), Jan 1, and Seollal and Chuseok days; free; Korean guided tours, audio guide in KO/EN/ZH/JA/Jeju dialect; VisitJeju says wheelchair and stroller rental is available and tags it barrier-free. KTO image of the hall: https://tong.visitkorea.or.kr/cms/resource/12/4129912_image2_1.jpg. avg_stay_min is an estimate (about 40 min for the inn alone, about 90 min including the memorial hall or a meal).

RENAMED: The museum was 넥슨컴퓨터박물관 (Nexon Computer Museum) until it closed on 2026-01-01 for renovation. It reopened as 넥슨뮤지엄 (Nexon Museum) on 2026-05-12. VisitJeju's Korean title is already 넥슨뮤지엄, but its English page still says 'Nexon Computer Museum'. The old domain (computermuseum.nexon.com) redirects to nexonmuseum.org. Hours, prices and address come from the official site's visitor-info text in its JS bundle, plus the footer ('화-일 10:00-18:00, 매주 월요일, 설, 추석 당일 휴관'). The adult price went up from 8,000 to 14,000 KRW. The road address is unchanged; the jibun 노형동 86 matches the source data. Visitors can link a Nexon account for a personalized tour, and the museum suggests installing the Nexon Play app beforehand because kiosk sign-up is slow. The avg_stay figure of 120 min is an estimate: Inven reports visitors now plan 2-3 h, up from about 1 h before. ACCESSIBILITY: VisitJeju lists 단독접근가능, 단차없음, 시각장애인 접근성, 장애인 화장실, 승강기, 장애인 전용 주차장, 수동 휠체어 대여 가능, with assistance-need level '쉬움'. has_stairs=false means the visitor route is step-free per VisitJeju; the building itself does have stairs. Seating: news coverage says the 2F 'Save the Game' documentary is meant to be watched from seats. The official site itself has no accessibility section. The image is a 2014 exterior photo that still shows the old 'Nexon Computer Museum' signage, which may have changed in the 2026 rebrand.

Hours, closed days and prices come from the official visitor guide page; a few third-party listings wrongly say it is open all year. Phone numbers: main line 064-710-7732~3, ticket office 064-710-7764~5, guide booking 064-710-7762. VisitJeju lists the jibun as 교래리 산 95; the source data says 산 119. The road address 남조로 2023 is consistent everywhere. Zone walking times from the official course page: Stone Museum zone about 50 min / 970 m; outdoor exhibition about 50 min / 970 m; thatched village about 40 min / 1,080 m; Seolmundae Halmang Hall about 120 min / 1,800 m; 500 Generals Gallery about 50 min / 900 m. The zones overlap, so avg_stay of 150 min is an estimate for a partial visit. An EV shuttle runs about every 20 minutes with priority boarding for mobility-impaired visitors (per mom-mom.net, not checked on the official page). ACCESSIBILITY: VisitJeju lists 단차없음, 시각장애인 접근성, 장애인 화장실, 장애인 전용 주차장, 수동 휠체어 대여 가능. However, its assistance-need level is '아주 어려움' (very difficult), and the site is very large and spread out. That is why wheelchair_ok is 'partial' and has_stairs is null: the official site does not describe the terrain or stairs. Seating: the official course page lists roofed pavilions and restrooms among the amenities, and the convenience page lists a rest area (쉼팡) and cafés. The 2025 Seolmundae Halmang Hall has a nursing room and first-aid room per VisitJeju.

Name variants: 제주시민속오일시장 (Korea Tourism Organization (KTO) and the entrance sign), 제주민속오일시장 (VisitJeju), 'Jeju City Traditional 5-Day Market' (VisitJeju English). No official market website was found, so official_url is null. Hours 08:00-18:00 come from KTO data relayed by koreacharts; KTO also says '연중무휴', which only makes sense on market days. Trazy says it closes about 19:00. Market day rule from VisitJeju: '장날 : 매월 2일, 7일, 12일, 17일, 22일, 27일'. There is no market on the 31st or on other dates. Example: 2026-11-11 is not a market day; the next ones are 11/12 and 11/17. Whether it opens when a market day falls on Seollal or Chuseok was not confirmed. The Commons photo (taken July 2026) shows the entrance gate and roofed aisles, hence indoor='mixed'. ACCESSIBILITY: VisitJeju lists only 단차없음 and 수동 휠체어 대여 가능 (manual wheelchair rental), plus 화장실, 공용주차장 and 임산부 휴게시설. No accessible restroom or accessible parking is listed, so accessible_restroom is null. wheelchair_ok is 'partial' because the ground is step-free but aisles get very crowded on market days. Seating was not confirmed. avg_stay of 90 min is an estimate.

Run by Jeju City (Jeolmul Ecology Management Office). Hours and fees come from the official 이용안내 page; the fees have applied since 2013-05-01. Conflict: VisitJeju gives the exhibition hall and 상시관찰원 as 09:00-17:00, while the official page says 09:00-18:00 (tickets until 17:00). Several third-party sites give only a flat 09:00-18:00. Today (Nov) is winter season, so the trail closes at 17:00. Closed days: the official page lists none, and KTO/VisitJeju say open year-round. Deer feeding: VisitJeju says it is 'temporarily suspended', and the official site posted a suspension notice for 11/4-11/9, so treat it as not guaranteed. Visit length per VisitJeju: oreum course about 50 min plus enclosure and exhibition hall about 30 min, so avg_stay is about 80 min. The trail is listed as 2.6 km (VisitJeju) or forest trail 2.3 km / main trail 3 km (ktriptips/KTO). A visit limited to the enclosure would be walking level 1 and fatigue about 1-2. ACCESSIBILITY: VisitJeju lists 단독접근가능, 단차없음, 장애인 화장실, 장애인 전용 주차장, with assistance-need level '어려움' (difficult). The 상시관찰원 is explicitly designed for elderly visitors and others who cannot walk far (official facility page). The oreum trail is not described as accessible, hence wheelchair_ok 'partial' and has_stairs null. Restrooms and pavilion rest areas along the trail are listed on the official course and facility pages. KTO says a stroller rental exists, but mom-mom says there is none (conflict, unverified). Free parking. The Commons image shows the entrance sign stone (about 2011).

Name variants: VisitJeju Korean '제주칠성로상가', English 'Jeju Chilseong-ro Shopping Street'; also 칠성로 쇼핑거리 / 칠성통 / 칠성로상점가. Address conflict: VisitJeju gives 관덕로13길 12 (jibun 일도1동 1476-20, postcode 63277); the source data says 일도일동 1492-1; Trazy says 중앙로7길 15; Hotels.com says 중앙로5길. It is a street, so there is no single official address. The car-free section is 관덕로11길 (from Kumkang Shoes to Tapdong), about 360 m. For taxis, saying '칠성로 쇼핑거리' or 'Chilseong-ro, near Dongmun Market' works better than a street number. The phone 064-721-0827 is from VisitJeju and is probably the merchants' association (unconfirmed). Hours are not official. Trazy says shops close one by one around 22:00. A 2024 Money Today report quotes a long-time shopkeeper now working about 10:00-18:00, and says about 25% of units (77 of 310) were vacant in July 2024, so the street is quieter than older guides suggest. The '칠성로아케이드' name in the source data suggests a covered arcade section, but no current source confirmed a roof, so indoor='mixed' only reflects that the shops are indoors. ACCESSIBILITY: VisitJeju lists 화장실, 공용주차장 and card/cash payment, but no disabled facilities. Its assistance-need level is '아주 어려움' (very difficult), which contrasts with the flat paved street, so wheelchair_ok and has_stairs are null. The VisitJeju photo shows some shop entrances raised by steps. IMAGE: no Commons photo of the Jeju street exists (Commons 'Chilseong' results are all Daegu). The VisitJeju CDN image (.webp, 1242x900) was fetched and loads. Its reuse license is not stated on the page, so confirm 제주관광공사 terms before public use. | 2026-11-13: 제주 중앙지하상가 (80 m away) merged into this entry as a nearby spot; facts from VisitJeju https://www.visitjeju.net/kr/detail/view?contentsid=CNTS_200000000012176 and KTO https://ktriptips.com/eng/shopping/1023984; 'free' from https://showcaves.com/english/kr/subterranea/Jungang.html (2024).

Covers halal + vegan + English menu. Listed in Visit Jeju's Muslim-traveler restaurant guide; HappyCow says it serves halal food and has a prayer room. Traveloka/Wanderlog claim formal halal certification, but I could not confirm this on an official certifier list, so marked muslim_friendly. HappyCow reviews from Oct 2026 confirm it is operating and mention the English menu and vegan section. Phone 0504-3139-6652 (Polle and Visit Jeju). Coordinates from HappyCow (listing last edited 2021). Mandi chicken allergens not published.

This is the vegan-option pick. HappyCow and Spinach Guide say the owners understand veganism, there is a labelled vegan menu, and almost everything can be made without fish sauce. DiningCode also tags it 비건옵션가능. Spinach Guide gives the address as 용화로 14-2, but DiningCode (road address plus lot 616-72, matching HappyCow) and Harper's Bazaar Korea give 용화로 41-2, which I used. A DiningCode blog post describes a July 2026 visit, so it appears to be operating. Hours differ between sources. I found no confirmation of an English menu; reviewers say staff are English-friendly. Pad thai allergens (egg, peanut, fish sauce) vary by order and are not published. Phone 064-747-3676.

This is the Jeju-specialty pick. Prices are from Polle (11,000 KRW); older sources say 10,000. Google reviews from Feb-Jul 2026 on Wanderlog confirm it is operating. Expect long queues at peak times; no reservations. The English menu is unconfirmed: Wanderlog says staff help translate, while one April 2026 reviewer says staff speak very limited English. Momguk contains pork, so marked not halal. Phone 064-757-3393.

This is the meat-noodle pick. The shop moved from Samseong-ro to this Iho address; some English guides still list 삼성로 67. The Korea Tourism Organization record was registered in June 2025 and updated in March 2026, and Google and Polle reviews from 2026 confirm it is open. Prices: Polle lists 10,000 KRW, another source 9,500. The KTO record has photos at tong.visitkorea.or.kr (e.g. https://tong.visitkorea.or.kr/cms/resource/03/3497603_image2_1.jpg), but I could not confirm their license type, so image_url is null. One English-language review mentions an English ordering system, but I could not verify it. Phone 064-746-2222.

Prices are from Polle (Americano 7,000, Udo peanut latte 9,000). NOL World lists a lower Americano price (6,000), so prices may have risen. Polle reviews from early November 2026 confirm it is open. Hours (06:00-24:00) come from a KTO record last updated September 2025. Reviewers call it pricey but praise the view. Plant milk and vegan bakes are unconfirmed. Phone 064-702-0007. Bread comes out at set times.

This is the cheap Nohyeong pick. Hours and closed day come from the KTO record (updated June 2025). A June 2026 blog post and a Polle review from about 18 days ago confirm it is open. Expect lunchtime queues, hard parking, and an entrance at the back of the building. Menu includes ham gimbap, so marked not halal. Coordinates: no map listing found, so lat/lng are null. KTO photos exist at tong.visitkorea.or.kr (e.g. https://tong.visitkorea.or.kr/cms/resource/63/2870863_image2_1.jpg) but their license is unconfirmed. Phone 064-748-2654.

Status uncertain: the Visit Jeju and KTO listings were updated in September 2026, but the newest user reviews I found are about two years old, so confirm it is still open before relying on it. Pet-friendly, no parking, and the entrance is easy to miss (wooden door, then a garden path). Prices are from Polle and may be outdated. Visit Jeju photos are marked 'All rights reserved', so no image is included. Phone 010-6605-0953.

Name, coords, road address, phone, description, accessibility fields from VisitJeju KR/EN. Opening hours only appear on VisitJeju EN (usedescinfo) and are identical to the Jeju Fortress entry; the KTO TourAPI mirror (ktriptips) says open at all times with free admission, so hours are doubtful - verify.
